description: What happened in one transaction, by hash: `status` (success, failed, pending; unknown for Ethereum transactions before October 2017), `block`, `time`, `from` and `to` (each with its label: entity, wallet_type, label_confidence), `value` (the chain's coin sent at the top level: `amount` in whole coins, `amount_wei` exact, `amount_usd`), `fee` (gas_used, gas price and the fee in the chain's coin) and `token_transfers`: every ERC-20 transfer in it with token_address, symbol, decimals, from and to (labelled), `amount` in whole tokens, `amount_raw` exact and `amount_usd`. `usd_basis` says how each USD value was priced: transfer_time (the price at the transaction's minute) or latest_daily_price (only for a transaction from the last 24 hours not priced yet); null = no price. NFT transfers and internal (contract-call) coin transfers are not listed. `found` is false when the hash does not exist on that chain: the same hash format is used on every EVM chain, so try the chain it was sent on. Use when the user pastes a transaction hash or asks 'what happened in this transaction' / 'did it go through'.
